name: Takata Steelblade
summary: Takata Steelblade is an orc warrior stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. Dispatched from Orgrimmar by Keldran alongside Maurin Bonesplitter, he spearheads the Horde's local campaign against demonic corruption. His primary focus is eradicating the regional satyr population affiliated with the sinister Burning Blade.

sections.title: Sent to Desolace
sections.body: Takata Steelblade was sent from the capital to Desolace under direct orders from Keldran, an influential figure in Orgrimmar committed to uncovering and purging demonic subversion. Operating out of the isolated Tauren encampment of Ghost Walker Post, Takata coordinates military efforts against the Legion-aligned forces plaguing the barren wastes.

sections.title: Scourge of the Satyrs
sections.body: While his companion Maurin Bonesplitter attempts to track and dismantle the clandestine Burning Blade cultists directly, Takata focuses on their demonic allies: the satyrs. Takata has orchestrated aggressive strikes against Desolace's corrupted satyrs, decimating their ranks to break the cult's local power structure and halt their spreading taint.

faq.answer: Takata Steelblade is a veteran orc warrior stationed at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He directs operations against demonic forces and satyrs allied with the Burning Blade.
He was sent by Keldran from Orgrimmar to eliminate the threat posed by the Burning Blade and their demonic allies throughout the region.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Takata and Maurin Bonesplitter?
faq.answer: Both were dispatched together by Keldran. While Maurin attempts to counter the Burning Blade cultists directly, Takata focuses his military strikes on the satyrs allied with them.
The satyrs in Desolace are actively allied with the Burning Blade cult, spreading demonic taint and threatening the Horde's foothold across the region.

faq.q: Where can Takata Steelblade be found?
faq.answer: He is located at Ghost Walker Post, a Horde camp in north-central Desolace.

angles.text: Takata coordinates regional Horde defense in Desolace, working out of Ghost Walker Post to purge demonic infiltrators.
Acting under orders from Orgrimmar's leadership, Takata embodies the orcish duty to stamp out any remnant of demonic servitude.
A master swordsman, Takata's campaign emphasizes decisive martial force to cut down demonic infiltrators.
